hero.title: Tailor Made Trips
hero.subtitle: You imagine the journey; We and our local operators make it happen. Designed according to your dates, pace and interests.

howItWorks.title: How We Design Your Custom Trip
howItWorks.subtitle: A close and personalized process in 4 stages together with our specialists.

s1.title: 1. Tell us your dream
s1.desc: Tell us which destinations you want to visit (Egypt, Jordan, Greece, Türkiye or combination), how many days you have and your preferred travel style.

s2.title: 2. Co-design with the Operator
s2.desc: We connect with our operator at the destination to put together an optimal route proposal, high-level hospitality and authentic experiences.

s3.title: 3. Detail adjustments
s3.desc: We modify the times, add special activities or refine the budget until the itinerary is perfect for you.

s4.title: 4. Your private trip
s4.desc: Travel with maximum peace of mind: itinerary coordinated to detail and permanent 24/7 assistance from our team.

inspiration.title: Routes of Inspiration to Adapt
inspiration.subtitle: Any of these base programs can be modified according to your tastes, add days or combine countries.

cta.title: Ready to create a unique trip?
cta.subtitle: Let's talk about your plans and we will present you with an initial proposal without obligation.

hero.title: Open Groups
hero.subtitle: Choose a guaranteed date, arrive at your destination and join a group of travelers from different parts of the world with a guide in Spanish.

howItWorks.title: How does an Open Group Work?
howItWorks.subtitle: The perfect combination of convenient rates, frequent departures and the warmth of sharing the route with like-minded people.

s1.title: 1. Choose your ideal date
s1.desc: Our circuits have fixed and scheduled departures throughout the year, guaranteeing your departure on the date that best suits you.

s2.title: 2. Flight to the starting point
s2.desc: You buy your airfare to reach the starting city of the tour (for example, Cairo or Istanbul). Sueño Travel advises and supports you in the search for the best flights.

s3.title: 3. Integration at destination
s3.desc: When you land, the local operator welcomes you and joins you with a group of people from different countries who start the same tour on that date, always guided in Spanish.

s4.title: 4. Complete circuit and return
s4.desc: They take the tour together with hotels, transfers and excursions included, ending at the return point where you take your return flight.

a1.title: Guaranteed Departures All Year Round
a1.desc: Wide variety of dates to choose from depending on your vacation.

a2.title: More Convenient Rates
a2.desc: By sharing services with other travelers you enjoy preferential prices.

a3.title: Multicultural Experience
a3.desc: Meet and share experiences with people from different cultures and languages.

a4.title: Support on Flights from Chile
a4.desc: We help you find and coordinate your tickets to arrive just in time.
